tremborag.name: Tremborag

canon_ref.note: Says he met the Goblin King Velan the Kind about ten years ago. A Skill of his forces others to kneel. In 3.28G he swells into a huge muscled form in battle. Class not named.

tremborag.summary: The Great Chieftain of the mountain, a huge Goblin who speaks fluent common and rules thousands from an old Dwarf city. He wants Garen's key kept from the Goblin Lord. After Rags breaks out with part of his tribe, he vows to eat her.

ulvama.name: Ulvama

canon_ref.note: Tremborag's chief [Shaman]. She offers Rags an alliance and mocks her name as one a Human gave her.

ulvama.summary: A female Hob, the chief [Shaman] of Tremborag's mountain. She offers to ally with Rags on her own terms and scorns the name a Human gave her; Rags answers with a kick.

noears.name: Noears

canon_ref.note: Named for his missing ears. Casts lightning in the breakout (3.29G). Leads a faction of Rags' new tribe.

noears.summary: An earless Goblin in the mountain who plays the fool until he shows Rags he is a real [Mage]. He warns her to act humble, then joins her breakout and heads her spellcasters.

pyrite.name: Pyrite

canon_ref.note: The Gold Stone Chieftain whose tribe Rags absorbed (b2.rags_absorbs_gold_stone_tribe). Stands with Rags in 3.26G; named by her in 3.28G. Once lived in the mountain.

pyrite.summary: The slow-spoken Hob Chieftain of the Gold Stone tribe, one of the few who stand by Rags at Tremborag's feast. He once lived in the mountain and guards a captive there. Rags names him Pyrite, and he frees the captives in her breakout.

redscar.name: Redscar

canon_ref.note: Named in 3.29G as the head of Rags' Redfang warriors. A scarred Redfang warrior in 3.28G is likely him; the text does not say.

redscar.summary: A scarred Redfang Hob who follows Rags out of the mountain instead of staying with Garen, and leads the Redfang warriors in her new tribe.

greybeard.name: Greybeard

canon_ref.note: Seen in the mountain in 3.28G, named in 3.29G as a faction head. A rare old Goblin with a beard.

greybeard.summary: An old bearded Goblin from Tremborag's mountain who joins Rags' breakout and speaks for a faction of her new tribe.

termin.name: Termin

canon_ref.note: Named as the wagon's driver; his horses are Erma and Fox. Class not stated.

termin.summary: The driver who takes Erin, the Horns and the Albez door south from Celum toward Liscor in his wagon.

poisonbite.name: Poisonbite

canon_ref.note: First named in 3.31G. Fights with two poisoned daggers and leads a group of warriors in Rags' tribe.

poisonbite.summary: A sharp-tongued female Goblin warrior in Rags' new tribe who fights with two poisoned daggers and does not like being told to train.

cognita.name: Cognita

canon_ref.note: A Truestone Golem made by Archmage Zelkyr, called 'she'. In 3.32 Pisces says she was, and remains, the strongest being he has met. History only: known from Ceria's story.

cognita.summary: A tall stone woman, the Golem made by Archmage Zelkyr to keep Wistram. She guards the sealed upper floors, killed the five mages who challenged them, and named Ceria and Pisces full mages when they left.

illphres.name: Illphres

canon_ref.note: Called one of Wistram's best [Cryomancers]; an Isolationist. Dies with four others challenging Zelkyr's Golems in Ceria's third year; 3.32 confirms it. Ceria's telling makes some of her deeds bigger.

illphres.summary: The feared ice mage of Wistram who hid a frostbitten face under a mask of ice. She took Ceria as her apprentice, and died years before the story trying to beat the Golems that guard the upper floors.

calvaron.name: Calvaron

canon_ref.note: A sixth-year generalist [Mage] and a broker of secrets; Beatrice's partner. Killed by the shades of Archmage Nekhret's curse after Pisces robbed her tomb.

calvaron.summary: A cheerful Centaur student at Wistram who traded in secrets and was Ceria's friend. He died in the curse that followed the robbing of an Archmage's tomb, years before the story.

montressa_du_valeross.name: Montressa du Valeross

canon_ref.note: Of the lesser Terandrian nobility. Has the Skill [Layered Ward]. Pisces tutored her. In 3.32 Ceria guesses she is a full mage by now.

montressa_du_valeross.summary: A young Terandrian noble at Wistram who studies wards. Pisces tutored her, and she stayed his friend longer than most.

beatrice.name: Beatrice

canon_ref.note: A Revivalist. She blamed Ceria for Calvaron's death. In 3.32 she is said to be all alone now.

beatrice.summary: A quiet Dullahan rune mage at Wistram and Calvaron's partner. After he died she blamed Ceria for it.

charles_de_trevalier.name: Charles de Trevalier

canon_ref.note: Calls himself heir of his house; his nation is not named. A Libertarian. Presumed alive.

charles_de_trevalier.summary: A proud noble student at Wistram who hated Pisces and Ceria. He struck Ceria from behind in their exam and later threw Illphres' spellbook into the sea.

amerys.name: Amerys

canon_ref.note: Archmage of lightning and air who belongs to Flos's Seven; she calls Flos her lord, so she serves flos_reimarch. Alive when Ceria left; later state not given.

amerys.summary: A Human Archmage of lightning who serves Flos of Reim as one of his Seven. She stays at Wistram while she waits for her king, and killed a sea serpent on Ceria's voyage to the isle.

feor.name: Feor

canon_ref.note: Has spoken for Wistram for over a century and is a hero to the half-Elves. He exiled Pisces on pain of death.

feor.summary: An old half-Elf Archmage who has led Wistram for more than a hundred years. He exiled Pisces and sent Ceria away.
